definitions.congruent: Two figures of identical shape and size.
definitions.corresponding: Parts of two figures that match under a specified vertex correspondence.
definitions.included angle: The angle between two named sides.
definitions.hypotenuse: The side opposite the right angle in a right triangle.
definitions.leg: A side forming the right angle in a right triangle.
definitions.CPCTC: Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles are Congruent, after triangle congruence is proven.
definitions.median: A segment joining a triangle vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.
definitions.altitude: A perpendicular segment from a triangle vertex to the line containing its opposite side.
definitions.bisector: A line or segment dividing an angle or segment into two equal parts.
definitions.circumcenter: Intersection of the perpendicular bisectors of a triangle; equidistant from its vertices.
definitions.incenter: Intersection of the angle bisectors of a triangle; equidistant from its sides.
